versions.content: function ThrowAsException [SWS_CORE_00154] Upstream: RS_AP_00130 virtual void ThrowAsException (const ErrorCode &errorCode) const noexcept(false)=0; Throw the given errorCode as an ara::core::Exception . This function will determine the appropriate exception type for the given ErrorCode according to [SWS_CORE_10953] and throw it. The thrown exception will contain the given ErrorCode.
